metadata.title: MedOrbits Health Sectors
metadata.description: Career and study sectors within health and life sciences, linking courses, job types and employer types. Sector descriptions are general and are not guarantees of eligibility, employment or outcomes.
metadata.note: Expanded sector directory. Salary and demand fields remain null unless supported by published sources; course IDs require reconciliation against the current courses.json before deployment.

courseIds.note: Courses that commonly lead into this sector; not a guarantee of eligibility or employment.

salaryInfo.note: Only from a published official source with year; never estimated.

demandInfo.note: Only from a published source; never speculative.

dataRules: id and slug must be unique; slug is lowercase kebab-case.
Every courseId must exist in courses.json; jobTypes and employerTypes must use values defined in jobs.json.
A course may appear in multiple sectors; sector membership never implies eligibility, recognition or employment.
Never invent salaries, demand figures, growth rates or placement statistics; salaryInfo and demandInfo stay null until sourced with a year.
Descriptions must stay general and must not promise outcomes.
regulatoryNote must always point users to the relevant official regulator rather than stating rules from memory.
verifiedAt and verifiedBy must be null until verified, and set together.
The active field controls display only.
Course IDs are starter references and must be reconciled against the deployed courses.json before treating relationships as validated.

displayRules.unverifiedLabel: Unverified - confirm pathways and requirements with official sources.
displayRules.disclaimer: Sector overviews are general guidance, not career advice or a guarantee of jobs, income or admission.
